ITEM 1 | Pale tan and brown grainy mixture with visible long-grain rice-like strands, flecks of green and pinkish-brown bits, moist-looking, loosely clumped, sits in the upper left of the plate, roughly 8 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, covering about 8% of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Golden-brown crisp coated piece with bone protruding from one end, shaped like a drumstick, glossy in places with a breaded, slightly bumpy crust, about 12 cm long and 5 cm thick at the meaty end, sits on the left-center of the plate next to the rice | 150
ITEM 3 | Bright green whole string beans, slender and smooth with slight wrinkles, lightly cooked and still holding shape, arranged in a loose bunch about 9 cm long and 6 cm wide, about 1 cm tall, upper right of the plate | 75
ITEM 4 | Crisp-edged romaine-style leaves, pale green to darker green with white ribs, coated with a creamy pale dressing that gives a slightly glossy, moist sheen, mounded in the lower right of the plate about 12 cm across and 3 cm tall | 95
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale dressing clinging to the lettuce leaves, thin white sheen with small speckles, spread across the lettuce surfaces and pooled lightly in its folds | 15
ITEM 6 | Rectangular wedge with golden-orange melted top, bubbling and browned in spots, with bright red-orange pieces visible beneath a pale cheese layer, cut edges show a thin pale-yellow crust, about 8 cm by 6 cm and 2 cm thick, sits on the lower left of the plate | 105
